{{Quote|One of the more interesting sections was the interior hangar bay. This was not the main hangar that was used for shuttles and transports, but a hangar bay located deep in the middle of the mountain with no direct launch or landing site.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="Field Report">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''Hangar Bay''' was a massive [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in the middle levels of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].

==History==
{{Quote|It housed a collection of vintage spacecraft and ground vehicles dating from pre-Republic times. This hangar was well shielded, and a surprisingly large number of these vessels survived. Some of the more interesting specimens include an old Alderaanian pre-Republic 'sleeper pod,' a chemically-driven cryofreeze unit and one of the earliest known interstellar vessels. Also surviving was the original AB-1 'floatcoach,' the prototype of the landspeeder design in service today.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="Field Report" />}}
The [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] was destroyed in an [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|attack]] on [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Smugglers' Alliance]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TLCS" /> Several [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] after the destruction of the mountain, the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Garv Debble]] and his [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]<ref name="Erasing All Traces">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> of the [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]]<ref name="TLCS" /> undertook an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition known as the [[Mount Tantiss dig]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] search teams discovered a collection of vintage spacecraft and ground vehicles dating to the [[Pre-Republic era]] in the interior hangar bay, including an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[sleeper pod]], a chemically-driven [[Suspended animation/Legends|cryofreeze unit]] and one of the earliest known interstellar vessels, and [[AB-1 "floatcoach"]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] prototype. The New Republic [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later mentioned the hangar in<ref name="Field Report" /> his<ref name="CSWE Na'al">{{CSWECite|II|351|Na'al, Voren}}</ref> [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]].<ref name="Field Report" />

==Layout==
The [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] was located in the middle levels of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. It contained the complete complement of vehicles and ships that the [[Mount Tantiss garrison]] commanded. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] were stored on roof racks and maneuvered by [[repulsorlift shunt]]s into [[launch tube]]s adjacent to the traditional hangar bay. [[Assault shuttle/Legends|Assault shuttle]]s, [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]]s, [[GAT-12j|Skipray blastboat]]s and other support craft had a conventional hangar. The main hangar area acted as both the maintenance bay and garage: all repairs were performed on a vessel while it was still in the hangar.<ref name="TLCS" />
